scientific_integrity: Analytic finite-dimensional Schur reduction and uniform contraction prove the result; finite checks are supplementary, no external certification.
scientific_limitations: One Fourier harmonic with fixed \(m\); \(|a|<1/2\) and \(\lambda>0\); no growing-\(m\) uniformity or multi-harmonic conclusion. Older broad asymptotic literature may contain equivalent formulas.
title: A frequency-linear boundary correction for balanced Sobolev orthogonal polynomials on the circle
